issue.title: Production API keys exposed in a public repository
issue.body: A customer found our live production API keys committed to a public repository on GitHub. The keys grant write access to customer accounts.
issue.customer_impact: Any holder of the keys can modify customer data.

issue.title: Checkout fails for all customers
issue.body: Every checkout attempt returns a 500 error since the 09:00 UTC deploy. No orders have completed since then.
issue.customer_impact: All customers in every region are unable to complete payment.

issue.title: User can view another tenant's invoices
issue.body: A user reports that changing the account ID in the URL shows invoices belonging to another tenant. This looks like a possible authorization bypass.
issue.customer_impact: Confidential billing data may be visible across accounts.

issue.title: Widespread login failures
issue.body: Users are seeing 'session could not be created' errors on the sign-in page. Support has received hundreds of reports in the last hour.
issue.customer_impact: Many customers across multiple regions cannot log in.

issue.title: Webhook deliveries rejected after secret rotation
issue.body: We rotated our webhook signing secret yesterday and now every order webhook delivery is rejected with a signature mismatch.
issue.customer_impact: One merchant's order sync is delayed.

issue.title: Dashboard is slow in eu-west
issue.body: Since Monday the analytics dashboard takes around 20 seconds to render for accounts hosted in eu-west. Other regions are unaffected.
issue.customer_impact: Some customers in one region wait longer for reports.

issue.title: Invoice total does not match line items
issue.body: The March invoice for one customer shows a total that is 12 dollars higher than the sum of its line items.
issue.customer_impact: One customer was overcharged and is asking for a correction.

issue.title: OAuth documentation lists the wrong redirect parameter
issue.body: The OAuth authorization documentation tells developers to send redirect_url, but the API expects redirect_uri.

issue.title: Feature request: dark mode
issue.body: Several users would like a dark mode option for the web app.

issue.title: Export admin activity history for annual review
issue.body: Our compliance team needs a copy of admin activity history for the last 12 months.

human_override.reason: Audit review requested by the security lead; handle as a security investigation.
